title: IoT: Georgia and Israel deep edition

questions.q: In "Read your local market Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Cluster H, People and business support: Coaching, coworking and outsourcing fit; many founders need flexible support in more than one language.
Cluster G, Money services (regulated): Regulated money services; plan as a partner of a licensed firm. Check with a local expert.
Employment rules, notice and social contributions differ; read the one for the country of the worker. Check with a local expert.
Languages differ by customer: write the page in the local language plus English.

questions.q: In "Choose your sector Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Keep a local address and a named contact in the country where you trade.
Add tax and duty explicitly; never bury them in a price. Check with a local expert.
Secure each device: unique password, signed updates, only needed data sent.
Compare three models: sell devices, sell a monthly service, sell data reports. Pick by cash and support load.

questions.q: In "Register and license Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Partner with a local college, chamber or training body to find helpers and to practise.

Two different countries, two sets of rules. Pick the country first, then use that country’s list in every module. Check with a local expert.

Launch with 10 devices and a go or no-go rule on uptime. Check with a local expert.
